description: Temper plugin hooks: deterministic gate guarantee for /temper:intent. stage-marker.sh (UserPromptSubmit) records that a /temper:intent session owes an intent gate (the other stage commands are doors into /temper and owe none); verify-stage-gate.sh (Stop) refuses to end the session until the project's .temper/gates.json carries a verdict for it (any verdict, PASS or FAIL). block_stdin_wait.py (PreToolUse, Bash) refuses, in a Temper project, a command whose `cat` has no input while the command holds a heredoc: Claude Code leaves such a command's input open, so it would wait until the Bash timeout. hold_before_approval.py (PreToolUse, the tools that write a file) refuses, at Intent, Plan and Design of a /temper run, a write of a project file before the person approves the plan: with no mod loaded it holds the write rule the mod holds (a shell command and a /temper:fix run are outside it). All four fail open on every path except the one detected violation; the two PreToolUse hooks only ever answer deny (one JSON answer on standard output), never approve a call and never change its input. See ADR 0005, deterministic stage gate enforcement, and ADR 0012 in the plugin's docs.
